sn46.77-88:1.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, gaṅgānadī pācīnaninnā pācīnapoṇā pācīnapabbhārā,
sn46.77-88:1.2: evameva kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu satta bojjhaṅge bhāvento satta bojjhaṅge bahulīkaronto nibbānaninno hoti, nibbānapoṇo nibbānapabbhāro.
sn46.77-88:1.3: kathañca bhikkhave, bhikkhu satta bojjhaṅge bhāvento satta bojjhaṅge bahulīkaronto nibbānaninno hoti nibbānapoṇo nibbānapabbhāro.
sn46.77-88:1.5: upekhāsambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
sn46.77-88:1.6: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu sattabojjhaṅge bhāvento satta bojjhaṅge bahulīkaronto nibbānaninno hoti nibbānapoṇo nibbānapabbhāroti.
